question: Which sport is linked to the term "Grand Slam"?
solution: The correct answer is __**Tennis**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • The term **"Grand Slam"** is primarily associated with the sport of **Tennis**. • The Grand Slam in tennis refers to winning all four major championships in a single calendar year: the **Australian Open, French Open, Wimbledon, and US Open**. • These four tournaments are also known as the **Majors** and represent the most prestigious events in the tennis calendar. • Winning all four tournaments in a single year is a rare feat and is referred to as a **"Calendar Grand Slam"**. Players achieving this include legends like **Rod Laver** and **Steffi Graf**. • The Grand Slam tournaments are played on different surfaces: **hard court (Australian Open and US Open), clay court (French Open), and grass court (Wimbledon)**, testing a player's versatility and skill.
